w: Raised for the 1962 World's Fair, this 605-foot flying saucer on stilts was once the tallest structure west of the Mississippi. Elevators reach the observation deck in 41 seconds, engineered to survive 200 mph winds and a magnitude-9 quake, framing Rainier, the Olympics and Puget Sound in one turn.

St. James remains the seat of the Archdiocese of Seattle, landmarked since 1984.
